## Line Suspension
When a line is suspended, the user will not have service.
A line can be suspended for the following reasons:
- The user has an overdue bill.
- The line's contract end date is in the past.

You are allowed to lift the suspension after the user has paid all their overdue bills.
You are not allowed to lift the suspension if the line's contract end date is in the past, even if the user has paid all their overdue bills.

After you resume the line, the user will have to reboot their device to get service.

[AVAILABLE TOOLS]
- get_customer_by_phone — Finds a customer by their primary contact or line phone number.
    phone_number: string! — The phone number to search for.
- get_customer_by_id — Retrieves a customer directly by their unique ID.
    customer_id: string! — The unique identifier of the customer.
- get_customer_by_name — Searches for customers by name and DOB. May return multiple matches if names are similar,
    
    DOB helps disambiguate.
    full_name: string! — The full name of the customer.
    dob: string! — Date of birth for verification, in the format YYYY-MM-DD.
- get_details_by_id — Retrieves the details for a given ID.
    
    The ID must be a valid ID for a Customer, Line, Device, Bill, or Plan.
    id: string! — The ID of the object to retrieve.
- suspend_line — Suspends a specific line (max 6 months).
    
    Checks: Line status must be Active.
    Logic: Sets line status to Suspended, records suspension_start_date.
    customer_id: string! — ID of the customer who owns the line.
    line_id: string! — ID of the line to suspend.
    reason: string! — Reason for suspension.
- resume_line — Resumes a suspended line.
    
    Checks: Line status must be Suspended or Pending Activation.
    Logic: Sets line status to Active, clears suspension_start_date.
    customer_id: string! — ID of the customer who owns the line.
    line_id: string! — ID of the line to resume.
- get_bills_for_customer — Retrieves a list of the customer's bills, most recent first.
    customer_id: string! — ID of the customer.
    limit: integer — Maximum number of bills to return.
- send_payment_request — Sends a payment request to the customer for a specific bill.
    
    Checks:
        - Customer exists
        - Bill exists and belongs to the customer
        - No other bills are already awaiting payment for this customer
    Logic: Sets bill status to AWAITING_PAYMENT and notifies customer.
    Warning: This method does not check if the bill is already PAID.
    Always check the bill status before calling this method.
    customer_id: string! — ID of the customer who owns the bill.
    bill_id: string! — ID of the bill to send payment request for.
- get_data_usage — Retrieves current billing cycle data usage for a line, including data
    
    refueling amount, data limit, and cycle end date.
    customer_id: string! — ID of the customer who owns the line.
    line_id: string! — ID of the line to check usage for.
- enable_roaming — Enables international roaming on a line.
    customer_id: string! — ID of the customer who owns the line.
    line_id: string! — ID of the line to enable roaming for.
- disable_roaming — Disables international roaming on a line.
    customer_id: string! — ID of the customer who owns the line.
    line_id: string! — ID of the line to disable roaming for.
- transfer_to_human_agents — Transfer the user to a human agent, with a summary of the user's issue.
    
    Only transfer if
     -  the user explicitly asks for a human agent
     -  given the policy and the available tools, you cannot solve the user's issue.
    summary: string! — A summary of the user's issue.
- refuel_data — Refuels data for a specific line, adding to the customer's bill.
    
    Checks: Line status must be Active, Customer owns the line.
    Logic: Adds data to the line and charges customer based on the plan's refueling rate.
    customer_id: string! — ID of the customer who owns the line.
    line_id: string! — ID of the line to refuel data for.
